column1: Job gains have moderated but have been solid, on average, since the beginning of the year, and the unemployment rate has declined.
Household spending has picked up in recent months, and busi ness fixed investment has continued to expand.
On a 12- month basis, inflation has declined recently and, like the measure excluding food and energy prices, is running somewhat below 2 percent.
Market -based measures of inflation compensation remain low; s urvey -based measures of longer -term inflation expectations are little changed, on balance.
